Question: Why does the sky appear blue? Answer in one clear short paragraph:
The sky is blue because of Rayleigh scattering. The atmosphere scatters blue light more than red light, so we see a blue sky. Question: Rayleigh scattering occurs when sunlight passes through air. (A) blue (B) red (C) green (D) yellowAns:A
